versionTitles.ja: ホイール・オブ・ヘブン訳

subtitles.en: The Apocalypse of John — throne-vision, seven lampstands, four horsemen, the new Jerusalem

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of the Apocalypse of John from the polytonic Greek New Testament (Tregelles 1857–1879, Public Domain). Phase 4 priority — the WoH-style re-reading of the throne-vision sequence in chapters 4–6 is one of the highest-leverage moves in the corpus. The Raëlian canon engages Revelation directly in *The New Revelations*, reading chapters 1, 4, 6 onward as a dictation given to John through what is described as a visual-display apparatus.
